stats.done_summary: Implemented Temporal Stability Index (TSI) per specification (population std, ddof=0) and applied it to model_output in data/experiment_traces.csv. Generated required figures (time series, first differences, histograms, prefix TSI convergence, rolling ratio) under report/images/, saved scalar results to outputs/tsi_results.json and prefix series to outputs/prefix_tsi.csv, and wrote publication-style report to report/report.md including the TSI formula and full-series numeric TSI.
